Data preprocessing
```{r}
est_spatial_abundance_lr_iso = iso_lr$gamma/rowSums(iso_lr$gamma)
colors_provide = rep("black", ncol(est_spatial_abundance_lr_iso))
names(colors_provide) = colnames(est_spatial_abundance_lr_iso)
pos = data.frame(x = meta[rownames(est_spatial_abundance_lr_iso),]$imagecol, 
                 y = 50000 - meta[rownames(est_spatial_abundance_lr_iso),]$imagerow)
rownames(pos) = rownames(est_spatial_abundance_lr_iso)

est_spatial_abundance_sr = gene_sr$gamma / rowSums(gene_sr$gamma)


est_spatial_abundance_lr = gene_lr$gamma/rowSums(gene_lr$gamma)

for (i in 1:ncol(est_spatial_abundance_lr_iso)) {
  new_col = colors_provide
  new_col[i] = 'red'
  p1 = vizTopic(as.matrix(est_spatial_abundance_sr), pos=pos, size=2, high = "red", topic = i, plotTitle = paste0(names(colors_provide)[i], "(SR)"))
  new_col[i] = 'blue'
  p2 = vizTopic(as.matrix(est_spatial_abundance_lr), pos=pos, size=2, high = "blue", topic = i, plotTitle = paste0(names(colors_provide)[i], "(LR)"))
  new_col[i] = 'green'
  p3 = vizTopic(as.matrix(deconv_res), pos=pos, size=2, high = "green", topic = i, plotTitle = paste0(names(colors_provide)[i], "(Isoform)"))
  plot(p1)
  plot(p2)
  plot(p3)
}
```
# Boxplot for comparison:
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)


# --- Convert to long format and label ---
to_long <- function(mat, label) {
  as.data.frame(mat) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Spot") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(-Spot, names_to = "CellType", values_to = "Proportion") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(ReadType = label)
}

abundance_combined <- bind_rows(
  to_long(est_spatial_abundance_sr,      "Short Read"),
  to_long(est_spatial_abundance_lr,     "Long Read"),
  to_long(est_spatial_abundance_lr_iso, "Long Read (Isoform)")
)

# --- Split cell types into thirds ---
cell_types <- unique(abundance_combined$CellType)
third <- ceiling(length(cell_types) / 3)
cell_types_1 <- cell_types[1:third]
cell_types_2 <- cell_types[(third+1):(2*third)]
cell_types_3 <- cell_types[(2*third+1):length(cell_types)]

abundance_third1 <- abundance_combined %>% dplyr::filter(CellType %in% cell_types_1)
abundance_third2 <- abundance_combined %>% dplyr::filter(CellType %in% cell_types_2)
abundance_third3 <- abundance_combined %>% dplyr::filter(CellType %in% cell_types_3)

# --- Shared plot settings ---
read_colors <- c(
  "Short Read"          = "#619CFF",
  "Long Read"           = "#F8766D",
  "Long Read (Isoform)" = "#00BA38"
)

plot_boxplot <- function(data, title) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = CellType, y = Proportion, fill = ReadType)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, position = position_dodge(0.8)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = read_colors) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "Cell Type",
      y = "Proportion",
      fill = "Read Type"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5))
}

# --- Generate plots ---
p1 <- plot_boxplot(abundance_third1, "Spatial Abundance Proportions by Cell Type: SR vs LR vs LR (Isoform) (1/3)")
p2 <- plot_boxplot(abundance_third2, "Spatial Abundance Proportions by Cell Type: SR vs LR vs LR (Isoform) (2/3)")
p3 <- plot_boxplot(abundance_third3, "Spatial Abundance Proportions by Cell Type: SR vs LR vs LR (Isoform) (3/3)")

print(p1)
print(p2)
print(p3)
```
Gene Expression plot for thos significantly expressed:
```{r}
sig_celltypes <- abundance_combined %>%
  group_by(CellType) %>%
  summarise(
    p_value = kruskal.test(Proportion ~ ReadType)$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(p_adj < 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(p_adj) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 7)

cat("Selected cell types:\n")
print(sig_celltypes)

selected_celltypes <- sig_celltypes$CellType
```

Now plotting the gene expressions
```{r}
# --- Step 2: Map selected cell types back to row indices in reference ---
sampled_rows <- which(rownames(reference) %in% c("N3"))
sampled_cols <- sample(1:ncol(reference), size = 200)

celltype_names <- rownames(reference)

# --- Step 3: Build 4-row-per-celltype comparison matrix ---
# Rows: Reference, SR (gene), LR (gene), LR (iso)
comparison_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = 4 * length(sampled_rows), ncol = length(sampled_cols))

idx <- 1
for (i in sampled_rows) {
  comparison_matrix[idx,   ] <- reference[i, sampled_cols]         / sum(reference[i, sampled_cols])
  comparison_matrix[idx+1, ] <- gene_sr$tau[i, sampled_cols]     / sum(gene_sr$tau[i, sampled_cols])
  comparison_matrix[idx+2, ] <- gene_lr$tau[i, sampled_cols]     / sum(gene_lr$tau[i, sampled_cols])
  comparison_matrix[idx+3, ] <- iso_lr$tau[i, sampled_cols] / sum(iso_lr$tau[i, sampled_cols])
  idx <- idx + 4
}

rownames(comparison_matrix) <- as.vector(rbind(
  paste0("Reference: ",    celltype_names[sampled_rows]),
  paste0("SR (gene): ",    celltype_names[sampled_rows]),
  paste0("LR (gene): ",    celltype_names[sampled_rows]),
  paste0("LR (iso): ",     celltype_names[sampled_rows])
))
colnames(comparison_matrix) <- colnames(reference)[sampled_cols]

# --- Step 4: Visualise ---
visualize_reference(comparison_matrix, want_log = FALSE, cluster_col = FALSE, cluster_row = TRUE)
```
